scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Brackish Water Aquaculture Farms
other_conditions: Applicant must be a farmer with a water spread area of 2 hectares or less
The farm must be licensed by the Coastal Aquaculture Authority
Applications are accepted only in offline mode
benefits_summary: Provides subsidies for construction/renovation, equipment, and feed for brackish water aquaculture farms, with limits per hectare.
